data.title: Marriage registration appointment on 1 September 2026
data.summary: The registry office (Standesamt) of Verbandsgemeinde Musterweiler confirmed an appointment to register your marriage on 1 September 2026 at 10:15. The fee is €80.00, payable on site.
data.explanation: You and your partner have a reserved appointment to register your intended marriage (Anmeldung der Eheschließung). Both of you must attend in person and bring valid ID plus certified copies from the birth register (beglaubigte Abschriften aus dem Geburtenregister) that are not older than six months. The €80.00 fee can be paid on site in cash or by card. If you cannot attend, contact the registry office using the phone number on the letter.
